[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a recipe for Classic Basil Pesto Sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant created a recipe for Classic Basil Pesto Sauce with the following details:  
- Ingredients: 2 cups fresh basil leaves, 1/3 cup pine nuts, 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese, 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, salt to taste.  
- Instructions: Rinse and dry basil leaves, combine ingredients in a food processor, process until well combined, add olive oil, season with salt, taste and adjust.
